Primeway logo files
===================
Folders: svg (vector, layers: icon / wordmark / tagline), png (transparent), jpeg (solid background), pdf (vector).

Variants (same names in every folder)
- primeway-horizontal-color    Default logo on white or light backgrounds
- primeway-horizontal-white    On dark, gradient or brand-colour backgrounds
- primeway-horizontal-navy     One-colour print on light backgrounds
- primeway-horizontal-black    One-colour black: fax, stamps, newspaper
- primeway-vertical-color      Square or tall spaces on light backgrounds
- primeway-vertical-white      Square or tall spaces on dark backgrounds
- primeway-icon-color          Favicon, avatar, app icon (light backgrounds)
- primeway-icon-white          Icon on dark backgrounds
- primeway-wordmark-navy       Wordmark and tagline only, when the icon is shown nearby

Notes
- PNG: 2000 px wide (icon: 1024 x 1024 canvas), transparent.
- JPEG: white background; white logos sit on deep navy (#023144).
- Brand colours: Teal #04A595, Ocean Blue #055882, Deep Navy #023144.
